document.$description: Canonical AMC Mission Control design tokens (DTCG 2025.10). T1 primitive -> T2 semantic -> T3 component. Consumer code references T2/T3 only. Edit this file, then run `pnpm tokens:build` (or `make tokens-build`); `python3 compile_tokens.py --check` verifies the generated CSS is current.

primitive.$description: T1 raw values. Only definition sites may hold these. Zinc neutral + single restrained Emerald accent (the existing baseline).

size.$description: Major-third (1.25) type scale from a 16px base.

semantic.$description: T2 intent. Every color aliases a primitive; the name says what it is for, never what it looks like.

foreground-muted.$description: Below WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1) for normal text on background; use only for large text or non-essential decoration.

component.$description: T3 component contracts. Alias semantic tokens only.

light.$description: Light theme for surfaces that opt in with data-amc-theme="light". Same semantic roles; every pair below is checked against WCAG 2.2. Component aliases are re-declared so they resolve inside the themed subtree.
